mentions.name: Multi-source e-commerce analytics platform
mentions.description: An analytics platform that combines GA4, Shopify orders, and Meta Business Suite data into a single feature store for exploring audience segments, product popularity, and what is or isn't working, and for generating insights on next steps.
mentions.source_excerpt: used Claude Code to build a super analytics platform that combines the data from GA4, Shopify orders, and Meta business suite into a single feature store where I can wrangle the data to ask/answer any question I can dream of about audience segments, product popularity, what’s working or not, and get insights on what to do next
